data.mechanism: Lamtor5 (HBXIP) is one of the five Ragulator subunits. BAR2012 identified it, with C7orf59 (LAMTOR4), as an additional Ragulator component required for amino-acid activation of mTORC1. The crystal structure of human Ragulator (SUX2017) shows the Lamtor4:Lamtor5 pair under the Lamtor2:Lamtor3 pair, together forming the platform the Rags bind to, with Lamtor1 wrapped around all four.
data.mechanism_beginner: Lamtor5 is one of the five pieces that make up Ragulator, the platform on the lysosome that holds the Rag proteins. Without it, amino acids can no longer switch mTORC1 on.
data.boundary: Human cell lines (BAR2012) and a structure of purified human proteins (SUX2017). Shows that Lamtor5 is part of Ragulator and needed for the amino-acid signal to mTORC1; it does not show that every function of Lamtor5 runs through the complex (see RAGULATOR-CGASSTING).
